preamble:
  shebang: #!/usr/bin/env dotnet
  directive: package Reverb.Runtime 0.1.0
  header: v1
cells:
  [0] setup
      | using Reverb;
  [1] code id=root
      | var root = 5;
  [2] code id=left
      | var left = root + 1;
  [3] code id=right
      | var right = root * 2;
  [4] code id=join
      | var joined = left + right;
      | joined.Dump("joined");
diagnostics: none
